snippet.title: Empires of Black Powder: Total War + Card Packs | Next Fest Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Empires of Black Power - Demo Update Trailer - Next Fest
Command Napoleonic armies in Empires of Black Powder, now with a major demo update for Steam Next Fest!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5155770/Empires_of_Black_Powder/

Build your army from cards, open packs for rare Gold, Elite and Renowned regiments, and lead them through a campaign of battles, from a road patrol skirmish to the final stand at Open Field. Form lines, squares and columns, unleash massed volleys and cavalry charges, bring up the guns, or ride into the fight yourself as commander.

What’s new in this update:

All-new art for soldiers, battlefields and cards
A smarter enemy general with reserves, flank marches and his own temperament
Commander orders: Advance & Fire, Engage Target, Move Here
Massed volley and cannon sound, ten languages, full controller and Steam Deck controls
Big performance gains and many fixes

Play the free demo now and wishlist Empires of Black Powder on Steam!
